headline: Customers can download their own invoices as a CSV spreadsheet, with account checks preserved.
what_changed: Customers can download their invoice list as an accountant-friendly CSV file.
The download includes invoice number, issue date, total, and payment status.
The existing invoice list now uses the same customer-only selection rule as the download.
good_news: The export limits results to the signed-in customer, so it does not expose other customers’ invoices.
The file download has a fixed filename and is limited to the customer’s existing invoice data.
